pages.title: Session context
pages.purpose: Shows context-window usage, token metrics, estimated input makeup and session totals for one session, with a link to the active-context inspector.

elements.label: Refresh context
elements.effect: Reloads the session message history via _load(); disabled while _loading or when !_sameLocation.

elements.label: Active context
elements.effect: Pushes ActiveContextScreen for the same controller and sessionID.

elements.label: Try again
elements.effect: ProductErrorState.onRetry calls _load() after a failed first load.

elements.label: Reload recent history | Load older messages | Refresh
elements.effect: ProductEmptyState action: _load(older: true) when _olderCursor != null, else _load(); null while _loading.

elements.label: [pull to refresh]
elements.effect: RefreshIndicator.onRefresh calls _load().

elements.label: Try again
elements.effect: _InlineContextError retry calls _load(older: _failedOlder) (wired at line 451).

elements.label: Load older messages | Reload recent history
elements.effect: Calls _load(older: true) to page older messages into the metrics; label is 'Reload recent history' when _olderNeedsReload.

pages.title: Active context
pages.purpose: Inspector listing the messages currently in the model's active context (after compaction), searchable and filterable by type.
gates: widget.controller.repository is ActiveContextGateway && activeContextSupported (gate on the opener tile, session_context_screen.dart:382)

elements.label: Refresh active context
elements.effect: Calls _load(); disabled while _loading or !_sameLocation.

elements.label: Try again
elements.effect: ProductErrorState.onRetry calls _load().

elements.label: [pull to refresh]
elements.effect: RefreshIndicator.onRefresh calls _load().

elements.label: Search active messages
elements.effect: Sets _query (trimmed, lower-cased) to filter the visible messages.

elements.label: Clear search
elements.effect: Clears the _search controller and resets _query.

elements.label: All
elements.effect: Sets _type = null (no type filter).

elements.label: {type} · {count}
elements.effect: One ChoiceChip per message type present; sets _type = entry.key.

elements.label: <message type label> / <preview text>
elements.effect: Pushes _ContextMessageScreen for the tapped active-context message.

pages.title: <message type label> (User / Assistant / System / ...)
pages.purpose: Shows the full content parts (text, reasoning, tool input/output, files, notices) of one active-context message.
gates: body replaced by 'changed' notice when controller.locationRevision != location || controller.sessionHistoryRevision(sessionID) != history

elements.label: Copy
elements.effect: Clipboard.setData with the part's text (one button per content part).

pages.title: Subagent sessions
pages.purpose: Lists the parent session and its subagent (child) sessions; selecting one pops it back to the opener, which opens that session.

elements.label: Refresh subagent sessions
elements.effect: Calls _load(): repository.getSessionDetails + listSessionChildren.

elements.label: Try again
elements.effect: ProductErrorState.onRetry calls _load().

elements.label: [pull to refresh]
elements.effect: RefreshIndicator.onRefresh calls _load().

elements.label: <parent session title>
elements.effect: _select(parent): revalidates the session via repository.getSessionDetails then Navigator.pop(current) so the opener navigates to it; disabled when it is the current session or while _selecting.

elements.label: <subagent session title>
elements.effect: _select(child): revalidates then pops the screen with the chosen Session; the opener (chat _openRelatedSession / global sessions) opens it.

elements.label: Session actions
elements.effect: Opens overflow menu (PopupMenuButton) on each relation tile; disabled while _selecting.

elements.label: Continue {title} on computer
elements.effect: showSessionHandoff re-reads the session and opens the continue-on-computer sheet (the handoff dialog merged into it, slice-P3.11a).

elements.label: Pin session | Unpin session
elements.effect: _pin(session): revalidates then controller.setSessionPinned(id, !isSessionPinned(id), locationRevision).

pages.title: Export conversation
pages.purpose: Exports the session as complete JSON (server export, optionally redacted) or a Markdown transcript and saves it to a file.
gates: repository is SessionExportGateway && sessionExportSupported (chat_screen.dart:5469); otherwise chat saves Markdown directly via FilePicker

elements.label: Complete conversation · JSON
elements.effect: Selects JSON format (_json = true), clears error/saved state.

elements.label: Readable transcript · Markdown
elements.effect: Selects Markdown format (_json = false).

elements.label: Redact sensitive data
elements.effect: Sets _sanitize (local, not persisted) passed as sanitize: to exportSession; shows an unredacted warning when off.

elements.label: Save file
elements.effect: _export(): for JSON calls SessionExportGateway.exportSession(sessionID, sanitize) with progress, else uses widget.markdown(); then saves via _saveFile (file save dialog).

elements.label: Cancel download
elements.effect: Cancels the in-flight export CancelToken.

pages.title: Import conversation
pages.purpose: Picks an exported conversation JSON file, reviews its title and message count (ids under Details), shows the destination as one row and imports it to the connected server with one pinned primary.

elements.label: Choose JSON file | Choose another file
elements.effect: _pick(): opens the system file picker (json), reads and validates SessionImportDocument (size limit).

elements.label: Change destination
elements.effect: _chooseDestination(): loads repository.listProjects() (+ listWorkspaces() when capabilities.managedWorkspaces) then opens the destination sheet.

elements.label: Import conversation
elements.effect: _import(): SessionImportGateway.importSession(document, destination), verifies the returned session, then controller.refreshSessions().

elements.label: Open conversation
elements.effect: _open(): controller.selectLocation(directory, workspace) then pushReplacementNamed('/chat/<session.id>') (line 376).

pages.title: Import into
pages.purpose: Lists project folders, worktrees and managed workspaces as import destinations, the current one marked; hidden when there is only one place.

elements.label: <project or workspace name> / <directory>
elements.effect: Navigator.pop(context, choice.destination); the screen stores it as _destination.

pages.title: Note for the agent
pages.purpose: Edits, saves or removes the per-session note that is given to the agent.

elements.label: Note for the agent
elements.effect: Edits the note draft; onChanged rebuilds byte counter; readOnly while saving or not current.

elements.label: Save note
elements.effect: _save(): controller.saveSessionNote(review, text) then leaves the screen.

elements.label: Remove saved note
elements.effect: _save(remove: true): controller.saveSessionNote(review, null) then leaves.

elements.label: Refresh saved note
elements.effect: _load(): controller.loadSessionNote(sessionID), keeping the draft.

elements.label: [back with unsaved changes]
elements.effect: PopScope.onPopInvokedWithResult calls _confirmLeave() when the pop was blocked (dirty draft).

pages.title: Discard your note changes?
pages.purpose: Confirms discarding unsaved note edits when leaving.

elements.label: Keep editing
elements.effect: Navigator.pop(context, false).

elements.label: Discard changes
elements.effect: Pops true; _leave() then pops the note screen, dropping the draft.

pages.title: Continue on computer
pages.purpose: Shows the terminal command that resumes this session on the server's computer, with a hint to export for another server.

elements.label: [copy command, inside AgentCommandBlock]
elements.effect: AgentCommandBlock(commands: [text]) from lib/ui/widgets/agent_blocks.dart owns the copy button (clipboard write only); line is the embed site in session_handoff_sheets.dart.

elements.label: Export session
elements.effect: Navigator.pop(context, 'export'); chat's _continueOnComputer then calls _exportTranscript() which pushes SessionExportScreen.

pages.title: Open on another phone
pages.purpose: Shows a QR code and the opencode-mobile://session link that opens this session in the app on another phone.

elements.label: Copy link
elements.effect: _copy(): Clipboard.setData(link) (line 140) and shows a 'link copied' snackbar.

notPages.reason: ProviderLogo / ProviderMonogram / BrandTile pure rendering; no tap handlers or tooltips

notes: Chat openers are private methods of _ChatScreenState (lib/ui/screens/chat_screen.dart): _showContext:5690, _showSubagents:5703, _exportTranscript:5467, _openSessionMenu case 'note':5563, _continueOnComputer:5628, _continueOnPhone:5664; the menu elements that call them belong to the chat agent.

continue-on-computer-sheet: the copy button is inside AgentCommandBlock (lib/ui/widgets/agent_blocks.dart, not assigned to me); recorded as one element with file pointing there, line is the embed site session_handoff_sheets.dart:70.
session-relations tiles pop the screen with the selected Session; actual navigation happens in the opener (chat _openRelatedSession chat_screen.dart:5714, global_sessions_screen.dart:419 onward).
Glossary entries provider/context/agent/permission/variant have no InfoLabel usage in lib/ (only mcp, worktree, reasoning are used).
session_handoff.dart also defines SessionNavigationScope (non-UI guard). showSessionHandoff error paths use showProductError (no page).
session_relations_screen.dart:498 _relativeTime uses hard-coded English strings ('Now', 'm ago') rather than relative_time.dart.
